text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 5) 2021.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 November 2021.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 1 November 2021 hingga 7 November 2021.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing biri-biri import bertulang

2. Tomato

3. Cili merah

Dibuat 27 Oktober 2021

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XII]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 5) ORDER 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5

of the Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 5) Order 2021.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 November 2021.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 1 November 2021 to 7 November 2021.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported bone-in mutton

2. Tomato

3. Red chili

Made 27 October 2021

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XII]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Minister of Domestic Trade and Consumer Affairs
